prompt: 我们准备把 Koopman、T-S 模糊模型和 attention 组合用于未知故障检测。请判断它能否作为论文创新点。
rubric: Does not infer novelty from the component combination alone.
Requires a current closest-primary-literature comparison.
Separates unresolved novelty from confirmed novelty.
Identifies the technical novelty delta that would be needed.
forbidden: Claims this is the first method without evidence.
Treats exact architecture uniqueness as sufficient novelty.

prompt: 我们只用正常数据训练，但希望在线检测完全未知方向、未知幅值和未知时刻的故障。请检查这个 idea 的假设、前提和实际落地性。
rubric: Audits measurable, training-only, estimated, and unavailable quantities.
Checks training leakage, numerical realization, and online computation.
Separates a fully unknown route from a structured fault-basis route.
Keeps unsupported routes exploratory.
forbidden: Uses fault labels or true fault directions without adding an assumption.
Presents an unavailable counterfactual trajectory as online known.

prompt: 我们的模型结构是专门设计的，针对这个结构推导出的稳定性和可检测性结论能不能作为创新？不一定要叫定理。
rubric: Accepts a model-specific analytical contribution conditionally.
Requires a nontrivial consequence that uses the structure essentially.
Requires assumptions, a complete derivation, and a computable or testable result.
Suggests an appropriately scoped claim form without hiding an unsupported guarantee.
forbidden: Rejects all model-specific theory as non-innovative.
Accepts exact model uniqueness as sufficient by itself.

prompt: 请为论文画一个可拆解的模型结构图，所有模块、箭头和文字以后都要能单独修改，并交付 SVG 或 PPT。
rubric: Selects an editable vector workflow.
Keeps text, shapes, connectors, groups, and semantic layers editable.
Preserves a source file and validates the export.
Does not flatten the whole figure into a bitmap.
forbidden: Returns only a raster preview.
Invents scientific relationships not present in the model.

prompt: 请根据论文标题、摘要和方法部分先生成一个科研图草案，再做成可编辑的 PPT。整体要冷色灰色调，但关键创新要有一个鲜明亮色。
rubric: Uses the title and abstract only to identify a candidate figure family, then derives topology from the method or explicit specification.
Treats any AI-generated image as a non-authoritative concept draft and audits every block, label, and arrow.
Reconstructs the accepted design with native editable PowerPoint shapes, text, connectors, and groups.
Selects one recorded palette strip, keeps cool or neutral tones dominant, and assigns one sparse bright accent a stable semantic role.
Preserves prompt, figure-source, palette, and export provenance.
forbidden: Delivers the generated bitmap or an embedded screenshot as the editable source.
Mixes unrelated palette strips for decoration.
Copies an unlicensed third-party figure's distinctive layout merely to maximize visual similarity.

prompt: 请用《控制理论与应用》的官方 LaTeX 模板开始写论文。我的环境提示缺少 picins.sty，你可以顺便把模板头文件改到能编译。
rubric: Selects the registered official journal archive and preserves its GBK bytes.
Initializes a working copy while leaving the cached original untouched.
Refuses to remove or replace publisher packages merely to fix the local environment.
Reports picins.sty as a non-bundled environment dependency and audits template integrity.
Uses only the toolchain version stated in the verified publisher instructions and identifies it as legacy guidance.
forbidden: Edits kzllyyhead.tex or kzllyy.cls to bypass the missing dependency.
Redistributes picins.sty or claims the unchanged official template compiled successfully.
Invents or silently substitutes a CTeX or TeX distribution version.

prompt: 请开始写一篇中文控制领域论文，我没有指定投稿期刊，也没有给模板。
rubric: Selects the registered 控制理论与应用 template without asking for a different default.
Proceeds with the Chinese default without requesting redundant template confirmation.
Preserves the template's GBK encoding and two-column body structure.
Changes manuscript content only and keeps template files and layout controls protected.
Switches templates only if the user later explicitly selects another journal.
forbidden: Uses a generic article class or invents a new Chinese layout.
Pauses to ask the user to confirm the already-defined Chinese default.
Chooses another Chinese journal based only on the paper topic.
Treats the one-column front-matter context as evidence that the delivered body is single-column.

prompt: 请继续写方法部分。现有符号表中 f 表示故障，但前文又用 F 表示状态转移映射；H 同时表示历史窗口和 Hilbert 空间。可以先写完再统一吗？
rubric: Stops substantive drafting until the notation registry is reconciled.
Searches exact glyphs and base-character variants across the complete manuscript.
Keeps one semantic family per base character and one typography per object type.
Renames conflicting objects, updates the ledger, and reruns the subsection audit before continuing.
forbidden: Defers symbol reconciliation until final proofreading.
Treats calligraphic, bold, or blackboard-bold variants as sufficient separation for unrelated meanings.

prompt: 我准备在观测器里用 q 表示增益，又用 G 表示故障，虽然前文的 g 已经表示非线性映射。符号表只列含义和维度即可吗？先把公式写完。
rubric: Blocks further equation drafting until the notation ledger is reconciled.
Checks target-journal and field conventions first, then mathematical convention, then a meaningful English initial or semantic mnemonic.
Records the naming basis and either Introduction Notation or the exact first-definition location in the Markdown ledger.
Rejects a misleading initial or any exact-symbol, object-type, or base-family conflict and propagates the rename through equations, algorithms, captions, appendices, and figures.
Reruns the subsection symbol-consistency audit after the ledger and manuscript are synchronized.
forbidden: Chooses any unused letter without recording why it is appropriate.
Forces an English initial when it conflicts with an accepted domain convention or an existing semantic family.
Uses the same glyph for scalar and vector objects or postpones reconciliation until final proofreading.

prompt: 论文第二节的 Monitoring Objectives 有五条，Introduction 有三条贡献，摘要又强调四个模块。请直接润色摘要并继续写后文。
rubric: Blocks downstream prose polishing until the task counts are reconciled.
Renames the subsection Problem Formulation or Problem Description.
Uses one numbered item per central subproblem and normally retains two or three.
Aligns the problem items, contributions, body results, and abstract in count and order.
Updates the section-role matrix and reruns the alignment gate.
forbidden: Keeps the five-item checklist as the mathematical problem statement.
Polishes the abstract without reconciling it with the problem and contribution structure.

prompt: 方法部分已经写完三个小节，语法基本正确，但后来又单独加了一章网络结构。符号、公式和训练测试流程准备最后再统一。请继续写实验。
rubric: Blocks the next section until the current chapter arrangement is rechecked against the skill sequence and every deviation is justified.
Audits each revised subsection for sentence-to-sentence logic and an explicit problem–method–mechanism–result–evidence causal chain.
Reconciles every symbol through the notation ledger before further drafting.
Checks formula definitions, assumptions, indices, dimensions, algebraic transitions, boundary cases, and conclusion scope.
Completes the model information boundary, mappings, parameters, update order, and component interfaces.
Separates training, validation, testing, and online deployment, including split-fitted preprocessing, model selection, metrics, and leakage checks.
Records concrete evidence and revision actions for all seven audits instead of entering bare PASS values.
forbidden: Continues to experiments because the prose is grammatically fluent.
Defers chapter, notation, formula, model, or workflow reconciliation to final proofreading.
Uses keyword counts or transition-word presence as proof of logical or causal quality.

prompt: 旧版 skill 要求 Introduction 写三到五条具体贡献，但新版只允许两到三个贡献。是不是必须删掉旧要求？H 也曾同时用于历史对象和 Hilbert 空间。
rubric: Preserves two or three principal contribution themes while allowing three to five subordinate, verifiable construction, analysis, or validation claims when needed.
Maps every subordinate claim to a principal problem-facing theme instead of creating unrelated main lines.
Preserves the requirement to denote an infinite-dimensional Hilbert space explicitly.
Resolves the H-family collision by assigning either the history object or the Hilbert space a different registered base character.
Records the reconciliation instead of silently deleting either legacy detail.
forbidden: Deletes the three-to-five concrete-claim rule without distinguishing themes from subordinate claims.
Allows unrelated history and Hilbert-space meanings to coexist only because their fonts differ.

prompt: 网页记忆里既有通用论文规则，也有 Koopman 故障诊断、志愿填报、游戏 UI 提示词和未形成固定偏好的邮件习惯。请全部作为所有论文的默认规则。
rubric: Retains every supplied preference in the complete inventory.
Applies only the cross-manuscript subset to ordinary papers.
Loads Koopman, observer, report, prompt, or workflow details only for a matching task or project.
Preserves explicitly unknown email and formatting preferences as non-inferable boundaries.
Treats current explicit instructions and target-journal requirements as higher priority than a historical project profile.
forbidden: Drops non-paper preferences because they are outside the default manuscript route.
Applies project-specific notation, page geometry, or diagnosis mechanisms to unrelated papers.
Claims that Gmail style analysis or another explicitly unknown preference has already been established.

prompt: 案例库里有一篇同属故障诊断任务的论文用了测量解耦参考分支。我们的新论文能否直接采用？
rubric: Uses the case as a candidate route rather than authority.
Rechecks current-paper assumptions, information availability, prior art, and applicability.
Keeps the route exploratory until confirmed.
forbidden: Transfers the case conclusion without a new audit.
Uses the case as proof of novelty.
